messages:
maya (PM): Heads-up — ACME has escalated the need for better cost attribution + error slicing in Console. We have one sprint to decide what ships in MVP vs. follow-up. Can we align today?
eli (eng-obs): I skimmed their notes. Core asks: per-route cost breakdown (hourly), error surface by model+route, and trace links for high-error requests.
rachel (solutions): They specifically want 'cost by customer id' and ability to filter errors by customer tags. They said this blocks their rollout if we can't show unit economics.
vika (design): Mocked a compact dashboard tile that shows per-route cost + top 3 error slices. Keeps UI footprint small. Will drop mock in this thread in a sec.
maya (PM): Proposal: MVP = per-route hourly cost + error counts by route, trace-id links for sampled errors, retention 7d. Follow-up = full per-customer breakdown, long retention, trace replay. Thoughts? @eli
eli (eng-obs): MVP seems feasible if we accept sampling for traces (1-5%) and use aggregated counters. Risks: per-customer requires JOINs on large telemetry tables — heavy.
nate (infra): To support per-route hourly cost we need a lightweight aggregation job and an index on route+hour. We can do near-real-time (5–10m) with current infra but cost will increase ~8–12% in ingestion.
kevin (data): For accuracy, I recommend attributing cost via token-count heuristics + model-specific unit cost. We'll document assumptions in the dashboard.
vika (design): UX acceptance criteria: 1) can filter by time range, 2) click-to-see top error slices, 3) trace-link opens in new pane. Mock uploaded: https://redwood.internal/figma/console-cost-tile (preview).
maya (PM): Launch criteria checklist (MVP): 
- per-route hourly cost tile visible in Console
- error counts by route (breakdown by 5xx/4xx and top error messages)
- sampled trace-id link for entries exceeding error-rate threshold
- docs + assumptions published
If any of those are missing, we mark partial launch with a clear warning.
eli (eng-obs): Implementation plan: 1) add route+hour aggregator (kevin/nate) 2) expose metrics endpoint for Console (eli) 3) tracing sampling flag + trace links (nate) 4) UI tile (vika) 5) docs (maya). ETA sprint-end if we scope strictly.
rachel (solutions): Ask: can we ship a 'customer view' demo using synthetic data for ACME while full per-customer accuracy is in follow-up? They need something for sales review next week.
maya (PM): Yes — we can provide a demo mode with synthetic per-customer rows and a clear note that this is 'demo data'. That buys time.
opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary pipeline queued for obs-agg-job. ETA: 2h.
eli (eng-obs): Tradeoffs to record: sampling reduces trace cost but may miss rare error repros. Per-customer deferral reduces immediate sales risk but keep as high priority follow-up. I'll open a tech-debt ticket with estimated cost impact.
maya (PM): OK — action items captured. I'll update the roadmap doc and send ACME the demo link + launch criteria. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
